profiles.biography: Phillip Haines is a brass/music adjudicator for Drum Corps International and Bands of America, judging the Music Brass and Music Analysis captions at DCI World Championships, and is a listed adjudicator with the Michigan Competing Band Association. A longtime music educator, he has been a band director in the Las Vegas area (Pinecrest, Sierra Vista, and Las Vegas High Schools) and an associate professor in the music education program at UNLV, and is a recipient of a Nevada Music Educators Association Lifetime Achievement award.
